evidence.ACL: Complete tear of ACL and PCL
evidence.MCL: High grade partial tear at proximal MCL
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Myxoid change of the medial meniscus with radial tear at posterior horn
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Horizontal tear at anterior horn lateral meniscus, with complex tear at meniscal body and radial tear at posterior root of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Chondrosis of the medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint
evidence.Lateral OA: Small full-thickness cartilaginous defect, about 3mm., at posterior lateral tibial plateau with subchondral bone edema, chondropathy grade4.
evidence.PF OA: Fissuring cartilage at patellar apex without subchondral bone lesion, Chondropathy grade2
evidence.Effusion: Moderate joint effusion with fluid distended suprapatellar bursa
evidence.Synovitis: Mild synovitis of the knee and PF joint.
evidence.Contusion: Mild bone contusion at posterior lateral proximal tibia is observed.
